concepts.title: Hardware Drivers (`src/core/`)
concepts.desc: Direct physical hardware drivers. Controls screen pixels, reads tactile buttons, accesses the MicroSD card, and animates BMO.

concepts.title: 14 Emulator Engines (`src/emulators/`)
concepts.desc: 14 standalone retro console engines (GB, GBC, NES, SMS, PCE, Atari, Pico-8, Genesis, SNES, WonderSwan, NGP, Lynx, Coleco, DOOM).

concepts.title: Main Dispatch & State Machine (`BmoGameboy.ino`)
concepts.desc: The central coordinator: handles boot splash, console carousel, game selection, in-game frame loop, pause overlay, and sleep screensaver.

concepts.title: Guardian Safety Suite (`tools/guardian/`)
concepts.desc: Automated guardrail suite checking memory limits, SPI timing, code density, and verifying pin mappings against soldered hardware.

concepts.title: Browser Simulator & 3D BMO (`tools/bmo_simulator/`)
concepts.desc: Zero-install web playtester running compiled WASM emulator cores and an accurate 3D Three.js model of the physical console.

concepts.title: 3D Enclosure CAD (`tools/enclosure/`)
concepts.desc: Parametric Python script that outputs 3D-printable split-shell STL pieces and GLB assemblies tailored for the soldered perfboard.

tours.title: Tour 1: Power-On to Playing a Game

steps.title: MCU Setup & SPI Bus Init
steps.summary: ESP32-S3 boots up, initializes Serial, sets up the shared SPI bus arbiter (SpiArbiter::init), and mounts the ST7789 display.

steps.title: BMO Boot Splash
steps.summary: Plays the boot splash animation with BMO's face on screen while reading internal hardware diagnostics.

steps.title: MicroSD Fast-Mount & ROM Scan
steps.summary: Checks for the binary `.bmo_index` cache to load up to 36,000 games in under 15ms. If missing, it scans the SD directory hierarchy.

steps.title: Carousel Console Selection
steps.summary: Renders the interactive console carousel with spring physics. The user selects a console (e.g. Game Boy, SNES, DOOM).

steps.title: Game Boot & Frame Stream
steps.summary: Loads the chosen ROM from SD into PSRAM, initializes the matching emulator core, and begins 60 FPS scanline streaming.

tours.title: Tour 2: Button Press to Screen Pixel

steps.title: Atomic GPIO Polling
steps.summary: Reads ESP32-S3 hardware registers (`GPIO_IN_REG` and `GPIO_IN1_REG`) in a single cycle without calling slow digitalRead().

steps.title: Debounce & Edge Detection
steps.summary: Maintains pressed, released, and changed flags so games can tell between a rapid tap vs a continuous button hold.

steps.title: Emulator Joypad State Update
steps.summary: Each emulator core maps the 12 BMO buttons to its native gamepad (e.g. A/B for Game Boy, A/B/X/Y/L/R for SNES, Arrows/Ctrl for DOOM).

steps.title: Pixel Push via 80MHz SPI
steps.summary: Outputs pre-swapped BGR565 video buffers directly to the ST7789 display window with custom console bezel borders.

tours.title: Tour 3: Why Guardian Tests Protect Hardware

steps.title: No Plain malloc() Allowed
steps.summary: ESP32-S3 internal DRAM is capped at 327 KB. The AST linter flags any large array or malloc that forgot to use PSRAM (8 MB).

steps.title: Hard Stops for Soldered Board
steps.summary: FEATURE_BATTERY_MONITOR=0 and FEATURE_AUDIO=0 prevent floating GPIO reads and DMA conflicts on pins that are not yet wired.

steps.title: Dynamic PSRAM Sizing
steps.summary: Slices PSRAM dynamically so catalog lists, UI buffers, and the DOOM 3D zone never collide or exceed the 8 MB Octal RAM ceiling.
